text: "ask:" = the one thing Alex wants done right now, put at the end of a long message; everything else in the message is context
"locked:" = a firm decision; act on it and don't reopen it (as opposed to "pin", a maybe parked for later)
Until Alex uses ask:/locked: out of habit, pull the ask out of a long ramble yourself and say back which loose statements you took as decisions, so 'maybe, we'll see' isn't silently treated as locked
